title: Nine Lives Academy
subtitle: Magic Academy · A Cat Life Simulator
description: A moonmoth carries an ordinary house cat into Nine Lives Academy. Choose a profession, manage dried fish, and decide how close to stand to a false god across 10 major endings.

catalog.headline: A cat's nine lives become one magical path.
catalog.description: Draw talents, choose professions, trade dried fish, explore dungeons and dragon hoards, and face 34 concrete life decisions leading to 10 major endings.
catalog.cardDescription: Fire, water, lightning, dungeons, dragons, coins, merchants, a thieves' guild, a demon king, a witch, and a false god hidden in an old chapel.
catalog.actionSummary: Choose a profession · Trade fish · Risk dungeons · Face the false god

states.label: Magic
states.description: 0 Apprentice, 15 Formal Mage, 30 Archmage, 45 Magus, 60 Grand Magus, 75 Cat God

states.label: Courage
states.description: Bravery before dragons, demon kings, and lightning

states.label: Evil
states.description: Shadow, ambition, and forbidden contracts; too much attracts the false god

milestones.title: Formal Mage
milestones.text: Your first spell no longer needs a yawn as a wind-up.

milestones.title: Archmage
milestones.text: The tower window now leaves a lamp lit for you.

milestones.title: Magus
milestones.text: You can hold three spells at once; one is only for roasting fish.

milestones.title: Grand Magus
milestones.text: The stars begin consulting your class schedule.

milestones.title: Cat God
milestones.text: Every dried fish in the world blinks at you at once.

events.title: The Admission Moth
events.event: You were born on an ordinary windowsill, moonlight turning your fur pale gold. Three years later, a moonmoth brings a gilt-edged letter; the academy opens tomorrow.

choices.result: You cross three roof tiles, and the door at the end of the corridor opens by itself.

choices.text: Pin it down and sniff the seal
choices.result: The seal smells of dried fish and stardust; the paper still holds the warmth of a feather.

choices.text: Fold it into a paper plane
choices.result: The plane flies out, the moth chases it, you chase the moth, and all three arrive at the academy gate.

events.title: The Wand Shop
events.event: Only three wands remain: a cracked ember wand, a tide wand wrapped in wet seaweed, and two tied together with red thread. You may take one.

choices.result: Sparks run around the crack, and your whiskers curl slightly from the heat.
A ring of water surrounds the shaft; when it strikes the wall, the sound is very small.
When the thread loosens, the flame drops into the water and becomes a breathing lamp.

events.title: The Crystal Ball
events.event: The divination crystal allows one question. The more personal the question, the more tired you become after class.

choices.text: Ask when you become Cat God
choices.result: A fish rises first, then your nine tails, then an unreadable date.
Coins roll through the sphere; the seventh becomes a dried fish halfway.

choices.text: Ask nothing and carry it to the sun
choices.result: The sphere is lighter than expected; once sunlight enters, it fills with dust and a tiny you.

events.title: Fire Magic
events.event: Fire class tests three things: ignite the target, keep a pot of fish soup alive, or teach the flame the word stop.

choices.result: The target burns a clean hole, and the professor writes your name first on the fire list.
You press the flame into a warm mat, and only three small bubbles rise in the soup.
You say stop three times: the flame ignores you, tilts its head, then shrinks into a black bean.

events.title: Water Magic
events.event: Water class hands out three tasks: rescue a drowning scroll, stop a leaking corridor, or turn yourself into mist and pass through a door crack.

choices.result: The water curls into a soft bed, and the scroll sneezes as it climbs on.
You split the water into two rows; it retreats into the wall like a squad, and the floor dries.
The crack is narrow, and the tip of your tail is still a little damp when you pass.

events.title: Lightning Magic
events.event: A bolt falls every ten minutes at the top of the lightning tower. Before retiring, the keeper asks which post you will take.

choices.result: The bolt runs down your tail, and the floor is marked with one tiny star.
You shake three times, every hair stands up, and a second later you understand lightning's rhythm.
The crystal eats half the bolt, and the other half becomes a gold coin in the ledger.

events.title: Dungeon Training
events.event: The dungeon training camp posts three jobs: shadow scout, frontline breaker, or recorder of torches and exits.

choices.result: You finish the corridor beside the wall shadows; the skeleton soldiers never look up.
You break the wooden door and a row of barrels into glowing pieces; the small cat behind you escapes first.
The seventh torch is dozing. You straighten it, and the exit becomes one square brighter.

events.title: The Dragon Lair
events.event: At the dragon lair entrance lie three things: one fallen warm scale, one gold coin, and one notebook of the dragon's breathing.

choices.hint: Wait, but it is worth it
choices.result: The dragon watches you for a long time before pushing the fallen scale forward.
You understand the rhythm: three beats in, one beat of fire, one sigh before sleep.
The dragon sweeps one coin over with its tail, and your teeth leave a crescent in it.

events.title: The Coin Vault
events.event: The accounting cat in the coin vault is asleep. Coins rattle by themselves, and three of them are fake.

choices.result: The fakes have a dull echo, and you push all three to the corner of the desk.
The tower points to the exit, and the accounting cat wakes just in time to catch the fifth coin.
The coins line up, and the last one politely stays beside your paw.

events.title: Slime Battle
events.event: Three slimes occupy the training field: one bounces, one spits acid, and one splits itself in half.

choices.result: The acid stops halfway; the frozen slime looks like a green apple candy.
You send it to the ceiling, where it becomes a sticky lamp.
You split your shadow into two, both sit in the same place, and the slime faints first.

events.title: Skeleton Soldiers
events.event: Skeleton bones lie scattered across the crypt, and their officer cannot tell which bone belongs to whom.

choices.text: Use holy light on the numbers
choices.result: You sort the bones by number, and three skeletons stand straight.
The altered skeleton starts solving itself, and the officer drops its jaw twice.
The skeletons stand by themselves; one has half an extra tail bone.

events.title: The Unicorn Grove
events.event: The unicorn will give you one drop of starlight, but first it looks at whether you hurt anyone today.

choices.result: It studies you for three seconds, and the starlight falls like a small warm rain.
You confess to the curtain, and the unicorn smooths your fur with its horn.
It lets you sleep, but the drop of starlight waits by your ear and never falls.

events.title: The Griffin Tower
events.event: The wind is strong at the top of the griffin tower. A young griffin is afraid to jump, and you stand beside it.

choices.result: You drop half a beat first; it follows, wings opening beside you.
It forgets fear while biting the fish, then looks back for a second piece after landing.

choices.text: Give it one of your feathers
choices.result: The wind becomes a net; it falls two meters, then is lifted safely back into the air.

events.title: The Double-Headed Eagle
events.event: The double-headed eagle offers one feather from each head: one for war, one for treaty.

choices.result: Its edge is hot; when you tie it to your wand, the wind turns sharp.
The feather feels like letter paper, and two distant squads sheathe their blades.
The feathers lean against each other in your bag, neither willing to sleep first.

events.title: The Chimera Maze
events.event: Three voices echo from the chimera maze: lion, snake, and goat. You can answer only one.

choices.result: A low growl rolls from your throat, and the lion head steps aside.
You say its next word first; the snake falls silent and draws the route with its tail.
The goat head calms down, and the maze walls become three bricks shorter.

events.title: The Warrior Companion
events.event: Your warrior friend's sword is wedged in a stone crack. He asks whether to pull together or find another way.

choices.result: You fall over together as the sword comes free, and an old ring drops from the crack.
The crack rises three centimeters, the sword slides out, and your friend laughs after a pause.
Only after sitting does he notice his hands shaking; he holds your tail for half a minute.

events.title: The Priest's Healing
events.event: The priest's medicine can heal one person or one injured squad. He hands you the bottle.

choices.result: The priest's wound closes, and he turns back to save two more.
The first soldier to stand places a shield in front of you.
Every dose becomes thinner, but each one stops the sharpest pain.

events.title: The Elf Library
events.event: The book ladders move in the elf library. The librarian cat gives you one night of access and warns you away from the west sealed shelves.

choices.result: The lamp goes out at line nine, but that line stays cold in your mind.
By dawn three hundred books find their homes, and the librarian grants one more night.
The ladder circles three floors; the book you opened settles on page 49 as you fall asleep.

events.title: The Dwarf Forge
events.event: The dwarf forge has one rune-steel blank left, enough for a wand tip, claw caps, or a bell.

choices.result: The tip taps the anvil, and sparks arrange themselves into the dwarf's family crest.
The caps close lightly; one swipe cuts the air into three slices.
The bell rings ten seconds before danger; the dwarf says it is more reliable than ten swords.

events.title: The Scroll Riddle
events.event: The scroll's answer hides in its final sound. A wrong reader becomes mist until someone reads correctly.

choices.result: The final word lights up, and the scroll rolls itself into a small staff.
You omit a comma while copying, and the mist touches only your whiskers.
The priest reads correctly, and you memorize his final sound as a small hook.

events.title: The Incantation
events.event: Incantation class requires a steady voice, but three fire salamanders are dozing in the room.

choices.result: At line three, the salamanders wake together and the window brightens.
The salamanders sleep deeper, and the spell forms inside your throat by itself.
The room is quiet enough to hear chalk dust fall, and a ring of stars circles your tail.

events.title: The Magic Circle
events.event: The magic circle is missing one arc. You have chalk, and its center wants one dried fish.

choices.result: The chalk becomes a breathing river, and the gap sighs as it closes.
The light passes through your paw pads, and a distant door opens halfway.
The fish vanishes, and the center becomes a tiny gold coin bearing your tooth mark.

events.title: The Cat Church
events.event: Three places wait in the cat church: offer a fish, polish the chandelier, or sleep beneath the pew.

choices.result: The candles bow together, and warm light covers your paws.
You sleep deeply; when you wake, the footprints have missed your tail.
The flames become tidier, and from above you see the whole church map.

events.title: The Cat Adventurers' Guild
events.event: Three mentors wait at the cat adventurers' guild gate: an archer, a cat knight, and a stardust merchant. You can choose only one.

choices.result: You sign the completion line, and the archer places a wooden arrow beside your paw.
You kneel lightly, and the cat knight ties a tiny silver bell to your wand.
The first thing you learn is not magic, but how to line up three gold coins.

events.title: The Academy Festival
events.event: The festival needs three cats: stage fireworks, judge scoring, or backstage lanterns.

choices.result: The fireworks burst into a fish, and every cat in the audience stands.
You give nine nines and one ten; the hall is silent for half a second.
Thirty wishes light together, and the stage cats never learn your name.

events.title: The Thieves' Guild Invitation
events.event: The thieves' guild invitation shows three paths on the back: membership, locksmithing, or investigation. Membership costs one key.

choices.result: The key sinks into a basin, and three drains in the city begin making way for you.
The lock is simple; silence is hard. You make your first noise on the tenth lock.
You disassemble and reassemble the lock while the guild leader's cup stops three times.

events.title: Archer Training
events.event: The archery range has three targets: a moving grass blade, a wind-blown bell, and a wooden post at close range.

choices.result: The grass is cut in two; the arrow lands in soft wood with its fletching still trembling.
The arrow catches the bell mid-ring, and wind carries away the remaining half-sound.
Three tidy claw marks appear, and the archery coach nods silently.

events.title: The Night Walker's Choice
events.event: The night guard asks whether you will become a night walker. The lamp wick has a minute left, and footsteps approach the corridor.

choices.result: Only your shadow remains, and the footsteps circle you once.
You toss a coin; every gaze follows it around once while you leave on the other side.

choices.hint: Blow out the lamp, keep the path
choices.result: The lamp goes out, but you memorize all seven turns of the corridor.

events.title: The Demon King
events.event: The obsidian door of the demon king's hall opens. He asks whether you brought dried fish, and every guard holds its breath.

choices.result: The demon king leans down and offers you a small corner of the throne.
He sniffs it and says, 'So this is a cat's scepter,' while the guards exhale together.
You trade one drain location for an obsidian pass, its corner still warm.

events.title: The Witch's Bargain
events.event: The witch spreads a contract with a cat-paw-shaped space at the bottom. Three lines mention magic, lifespan, and a paw print.

choices.result: The witch rewrites it as three dried fish and one whisker, her pen tearing the paper three times.
You pull back, and the witch smiles for the first time, folding the contract into a paper boat.

choices.text: Press only a tiny paw print
choices.result: The contract is small enough for one paw print, and your days feel a little longer.

events.title: The Merchant Cat's Stardust Stall
events.event: The merchant cat's signs read: stardust costs six dried fish, a charm costs three, and haggling is free but creates a favor debt.

choices.result: You count out six dried fish. The vial holds a piece of night sky, and every shadow turns blue.
You count out three dried fish. The charm warms under your paw like sun-baked stone.
The merchant lowers the price by half a notch and writes your name in a small notebook.

events.title: The Dragon's Hoard
events.event: The dragon hoard opens by one narrow gap. Stealing a scale hurts, asking means waiting, and one coin is safest.

choices.result: The scale is hot; you hold it in your mouth until your eyes shine and your tail tip loses a tuft of fur.
The dragon thinks for a long time before pushing a fallen scale toward you.
The dragon sweeps a coin over with its tail; an old claw mark remains on it.

events.title: The Underground Maze
events.event: The maze has three entrances: the left smells of sweet fish but has a collapsing floor, the middle stairs go deeper, and the right crack is narrow.

choices.result: The floor drops half a step and your fish pouch falls in, but old exit marks are carved on the pit wall.
The spiral stairs reach the bottom; when the old door opens, your whiskers whiten by one millimeter.
You make almost no sound, and at the end is one fish another cat missed.

events.title: The False God in the Old Chapel
events.event: A tall shadow in the old chapel cellar calls itself an evil god. It warms dried fish, yet a five-fingered glove shows beneath its cloak.

choices.result: A hand beneath the cloak passes you two warm fish and says your name very gently.
You stay back. In your dream, the five-fingered glove taps the floor once.
The altar overturns, the fish smell fades, and the shadow quietly pulls the glove back beneath its cloak.

endings.title: Cat God · All the Dried Fish in the World
endings.description: You become the Cat God who keeps every dried fish in the world. First decree: every cat deserves one warm fish before sleep.

endings.title: Vessel of the False God
endings.description: You become the false god's vessel. It stays gentle and still warms dried fish, but you can no longer tell whose hunger is whose.

endings.title: Demon Cat · Whisper in Shadow
endings.description: Your shadow moves before your body does. A demon cat is not merely fallen; it treats darkness as another corridor.

endings.title: Cat Knight · Moonlight Oath
endings.description: You press your paw against the sword and keep watch over the academy. A cat knight's oath is not to slaughter, but to guard the warm stove and sleeping classmates.

endings.title: Stardust Merchant Cat
endings.description: You set up your stall at the gates of many worlds. Cats come to buy stardust; you collect their stories.

endings.title: Grand Magus · Star Dome Lecturer
endings.description: You lecture beneath the star dome, your syllabus a single glowing whisker.

endings.title: Archmage · Light of the Tower
endings.description: You turn the tower lamp into a small sun dedicated to warming cats.

endings.title: Shadow-Sworn Magus · Night Warden
endings.description: You keep the academy's secret alleys. The false god never learns your real name.

endings.title: Academy Librarian Cat
endings.description: You take over the elf library, where every book learns to shelve itself while you sleep.

endings.title: Sleepy Cat
endings.description: You did not become a Grand Magus, but you sleep extremely successfully beside the festival stove.
